dashboard.description: Cost per m³ by plant, designs by lifecycle state, stale prices and expired tests will appear here once designs are evaluated.

studio.description: Evaluate an existing mix or generate a trial recommendation, step by step, with every number explained.

library.description: Approved, in-production and trial designs, with versions, trial results and lifecycle history.

insights.description: Price, test and strength changes that deserve a second look will be triaged here, never as interruptions.

savings.description: Theoretical, approved and realized savings are shown side by side and never added together.

materials.description: Add a sieve test for each aggregate to unlock blend optimization. Test freshness and drift appear here.

prices.description: One matrix of materials by plant, with history, stale-price flags and Excel paste.

plants.description: Plants, their location and ambient profile, and the materials priced at each.

rules.description: ACI and Jordanian code values with clause references. Every value stays unverified until a QC manager checks it.

imports.description: Bring existing approved mix designs in from a spreadsheet, then attest each one to make it a baseline.

settings.description: Tenant settings such as plant limit, stale-price threshold and number format.

shell.noNotificationsHint: Critical alerts about strength results and expired tests will appear here.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the account your administrator created for you.
auth.failed: Could not sign in. Try again.

errors.forbiddenHint: This section is hidden for your role. Ask an administrator if you need access.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Your entries are still on screen; try again.

dev.title: Components
dev.intro: Every shared component in LTR and RTL. Theme and density follow the toolbar.
dev.chips: Status, source, evidence and saving chips
dev.tabOneBody: Material quantities per cubic metre appear here.
dev.tabTwoBody: Requirement, governing value and margin appear here.
dev.dialogBody: Designs are proposals that require trial batching and QC approval.
dev.popoverBody: Formula, inputs, rule and clause appear here.
dev.tooltip: Explains where a number comes from
dev.emptyBody: Add a sieve test for this aggregate to unlock blend optimization.

rules.intro: Code values and engineering parameters with their clause references. Every value starts as an unverified transcription candidate until a QC manager checks it against the licensed document.
rules.engineeringIntro: Engineering parameters are plant and workability guardrails set by QC, not code values. Empty values stay empty until QC sets them.

banner.title: {unverified} rule values are unverified and {missing} are not on file ({verified} verified).
banner.body: Designs cannot be approved on unverified or missing values. Open a rule to verify it against the licensed document.

verify.title: Verify rule value
verify.description: Confirm that this value and clause match the licensed document. This is a signed action and is recorded with your note.
verify.notePlaceholder: For example: Checked against ACI 318-19 Table 19.3.2.1, row S2
verify.noteHint: Type at least 5 characters. You cannot verify a value you changed yourself.

edit.title: Correct rule value
edit.description: This creates version {version}, which must be verified again. The current version stays in the history.
edit.reasonPlaceholder: Why is the current value wrong?
edit.warning: The corrected value will be unverified until a different QC manager verifies it.

hint.default: Enter the value in the rule's units.
hint.limit_max: A number, or a fraction like 1/3.
hint.limit_min: A number, or a fraction like 1/3.
hint.prohibition: true if prohibited, false if permitted.
hint.table: JSON table definition (rows, cols, data, interpolation).

import.intro: Upload the Jordanian code values as a CSV. The file is checked first and nothing changes until you commit. Imported values start unverified.
import.summary: {total} rows: {ok} will change, {unchanged} unchanged, {errors} with errors.
import.fixFirst: Fix the errors in the file and check it again.

materials.intro: The materials you design with, their characteristics and where each value came from. Every value keeps its source: lab report, supplier datasheet, or declared by a person.

empty.title: No materials yet
empty.description: Add a material and its characteristics. SG and absorption are enough to evaluate a mix; a sieve analysis is needed to generate one.

materials.fmMissing: cannot be computed yet: missing sieves {sieves} mm
materials.declaredKey: Key values typed by a person, not from a document: {fields}

drift.beyond: {field} moved from {from} to {to}, beyond the tolerance QC set.
drift.noTol: {field} moved from {from} to {to} (no drift tolerance is set).

sheet.upgrade: Attach a report to declared values
sheet.noTest: No test has been recorded for this material.

entry.intro: Enter what you have. Nothing is assumed: values you leave empty stay empty, and every value is stored with its source.
entry.sgConfirmed: I confirmed the water specific gravity (1.000 is not assumed)
entry.pasteHint: Paste from Excel: a row of sieve sizes above a row of % passing, or two columns. Values are read as % passing.
entry.wrHint: Water reduction at each dosage (at least 3 points, dosage ascending). Dosage is % of cementitious mass.
entry.sanity: {field} = {value} is outside the usual range {min} to {max}. You can still save it.
entry.sourceTitle: Where do these values come from?
entry.sourceHint: This decides how far the values can be trusted. Declared values are always flagged on every design that uses them.

sourceDesc.lab_report: From a lab report. The report file must be attached.
sourceDesc.supplier_datasheet: From the supplier’s datasheet (attaching it is recommended).
sourceDesc.user_declared: Typed by you without a document. You will be asked why.

entry.attachHint: PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB.
entry.reason: Why is this declared without a document?
entry.reasonPlaceholder: For example: bench measurement on site, report to follow
entry.warnings: {count} value(s) outside the usual range. Saved anyway.
entry.offline: You are offline. Your entries are kept on this device as a draft; save when the connection returns.
entry.draftFound: A draft from {when} was found on this device.

tier.designHint: Also needed for Generate. Anything missing is named as a blocker.
tier.optionalHint: Improves checks and models; never assumed when empty.

gradErr.too_few_points: A gradation needs at least two sieves
gradErr.unknown_sieve: {sieve} mm is not a standard sieve
gradErr.out_of_range: % passing at {sieve} mm must be between 0 and 100
gradErr.not_monotonic: % passing rises at {sieve} mm; it must never increase toward finer sieves
gradErr.top_not_100: The largest sieve must show 100% passing

plants.intro: Your batching plants. Prices, materials and designs are scoped to a plant.
plants.formHint: The code is how the plant appears in lists and exports.

empty.title: No plants yet
empty.description: Add your first plant to start entering materials and prices.

settings.intro: Organisation-wide settings and users. Engineering parameters live in the rules library, not here.
settings.insightMinAnnual: Minimum annual saving worth an insight
settings.sanityHint: Typed values outside these ranges are flagged but never blocked. Leave a field empty for no limit.
settings.requiresLabHint: When on, a design that relies on user-declared key values cannot be approved. Enforced when approvals arrive.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Create users, set their role and plants, reset a password or deactivate. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
users.newHint: The person signs in with this email and password. Share the password securely.
users.plantsHint: Admin and QC Manager see every plant. Other roles see only the plants ticked here.
